scope: Laphroaig 15 Year Old 2026 Relaunch at 46% and Laphroaig 18 Year Old 2024 Relaunch at 48%. Research handoff only; no runtime, image manifest, matching or price changes.
sourcePolicy: Official product pages, dated producer announcements and visually inspected official bottle photographs establish identity and notes. Relaunch years distinguish editions, not the bottling year of every bottle. Dailyshot links require edition-specific image and specification checks.

entries.maturation: Fifteen years in American oak casks; official product page abbreviates maturation to Ex American.
entries.caskStrengthEvidence: Producer presents a fixed 46% permanent age-statement expression, with no cask-strength claim; false denotes the standard-strength product classification.

record.name: 라프로익 15년 2026 리런치
record.description: 2026년 정규 라인업으로 돌아온 46%의 라프로익 15년. 아메리칸 오크 캐스크에서 15년 숙성해 피트 연기와 바다의 짭짤함에 감귤류와 은은한 단맛이 겹친다.

notes.nose: 오렌지 껍질과 자몽의 산뜻한 시트러스에 마른 건초, 바닐라와 은은한 정향
notes.palate: 연기와 바닷소금에 거칠게 간 흑후추, 따뜻한 향신료와 은은한 단맛이 이어지는 풍성한 질감
notes.finish: 긴 스모키 여운에 감칠맛과 해안의 소금기, 깔끔한 단맛

sources.evidence: Current page calls the 15 Year Old a permanent return to the core range after ten years. Page gives age, Islay single-malt identity and the three tasting-note sections. The front bottle and close-up label show 700ml and 46%.
Suntory announces the permanent return in 2026, confirms fifteen years in American oak casks and 46% ABV. Publication date is an announcement date, not a universal on-sale date.

notesProvenance.scope: Concise Korean paraphrases of current producer Nose, Palate and Finish; no old 43% edition or retailer notes. Tags derive from these notes.

photoCandidates.labelEvidence: Single green bottle cutout. Current white label explicitly reads age 15, 700ml and alc. 46% vol.; Royal Warrant refers to His Majesty the King. This is not the older 43% bottle.

labelCorroboration.evidence: Official scene photograph close-up independently shows age 15, 700ml and 46% on the current label.

cautions: Keep 2026 in the ID and English name to prevent a match to discontinued 43% Laphroaig 15 or the 2015 anniversary release.
No claims about chill filtering or added colour have been copied from secondary sources.
No Dailyshot price was saved or updated.

entries.maturation: Eighteen years entirely in American oak ex-bourbon casks; producer explicitly excludes other wood or sherry maturation.
entries.caskStrengthEvidence: Producer presents a fixed 48% age-statement relaunch, with no cask-strength claim; false denotes the standard-strength product classification.

record.name: 라프로익 18년 2024 리런치
record.description: 2024년 돌아온 라프로익 18년. 아메리칸 오크 버번 캐스크에서 18년 숙성하고 냉각 여과와 색소 첨가 없이 48%로 병입해, 피트 연기에 바닐라와 과일·허브의 풍미를 더한다.

notes.nose: 피트 연기와 달콤한 바닐라에 부드러운 토피와 구스베리
notes.palate: 알싸한 계피와 갓 구운 사과 타르트
notes.finish: 풍성한 과일 풍미에 신선한 민트의 허브 향과 피트가 이어지는 여운

sources.evidence: Current page identifies the returning 18 Year Old, confirms full maturation in American oak ex-bourbon casks, and supplies Nose, Palate and Finish. Gallery front bottle matches the new 2024 presentation.

Suntory announces the new 18 Year Old after nearly ten years away, with ex-bourbon maturation, 48% ABV, 70cl, no chill filtering and natural colour. Date establishes relaunch year; it is not a universal on-sale date.

notesProvenance.scope: Concise Korean paraphrases of current product-page Nose, Palate and Finish. Producer's 2024 announcement contains longer notes; these are not blended into the record.

photoCandidates.labelEvidence: Single green bottle cutout, modern white label with large age 18, 700ml and alc. 48% vol. Lower-right text mentions ex-Bourbon barrels and reads VIBRANT · HERBAL · PEATY.

dailyshot.evidence: Initial searches have not identified an edition-verifiable Dailyshot product. Do not map an older or ambiguous 18 Year Old solely from age 18 and 48% because the earlier discontinued version shares those values.

cautions: Keep 2024 in the ID and English name. Matching old 18 Year Old by age and ABV alone is unsafe.
No Dailyshot product or price belongs in the record without verified relaunch identity.
The 2024 image directory corroborates the presentation only; the dated Suntory announcement establishes the year.
